versions.changelog:
### Minor update to documentation only

- Updated SKILL.md to increment the version from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1.
- No functional or structural changes were made to the code or features.
- All documentation, descriptions, and instructions remain the same.

Initial launch of Wedding Toast Architect.

- Provides a structured, role-tuned 5-part outline for wedding toasts with per-section word budgets.
- Scans drafts for 16 classic speech pitfalls with CUT / SOFTEN / CHECK verdicts and safety scoring.
- Estimates speaking time at three standard paces (words per minute).
- All features run locally; no text or data leaves the machine.
- Designed for best man, maid of honor, parent, friend, and sibling speeches; not for vows or eulogies.
